value.command: node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-name-pattern="all linked test-name patterns use portable grouping" test/process-fixture.test.ts

value.author: pi-claude
value.text: Stalled-PR recovery. Root cause of all four failing checks (test 22, test 26, release gate npm, release gate bun): the tracker item's linked test command used a single-quoted --test-name-pattern value, and the portable-grouping audit accepts only closed double-quoted patterns without shell expansion (single quotes are metacharacter syntax on cmd.exe). Replaced the recorded command with the double-quoted portable form; no source change was needed. Verified with the process-fixture audit itself, which now passes locally. No test coverage was removed: the release-caller contract suite and attestation refusal checks are unchanged.
